data.body: **[P2] Keep an eventual flush after the caller times out.** When a worker is blocked in `export()`, this removes the queued flush, and `request_stop_when_idle()` then lets the worker exit immediately after that export returns. An exporter that buffers in `export()` and publishes in `flush()` therefore never publishes the terminal record if this is the last invocation. Cancel only the waiter while retaining or coalescing a fire-and-forget flush request that runs before idle shutdown; add a timeout regression with a blocked buffered exporter.
